cohort: 1243 pregnant women after 20 weeks of gestation who gave birth at Cayenne General Hospital between January and April 2019
finding: The study found a high prevalence of PE (61.4%) among patients with HDP, with the majority being severe (80.9%), but no independent factors associated with PE or severe PE development.
mod_finding: The study reports that delivery was by cesarean in 49.7% of cases, but does not specifically analyze this outcome in relation to HDP or PE.
